svg.title: Data Loom: 441 public commits woven into one fabric
svg.desc: Security & Research: 344; Apps & Automation: 8; Web & Design: 62; Reports & Publishing: 27. One central loom feeds one shared block. Each cell represents 1 commit(s); category colors divide the fabric. Moving signals illustrate flow, not live commits.

g.text: 15 PUBLIC REPOSITORIES / DAILY SNAPSHOT / CATEGORY = REPOSITORY WORK AREA
